facts.fact: The ministry announced that on 5 May 2026 it would present the draft decree governing the interoperability platform and introduce the national interoperability framework, data-exchange architectures, technical standards and security requirements; both were still at presentation stage, not adopted.

note: carried from interoperability by its own text; no document opened

facts.fact: The source says the government still needs to set an interoperability framework defining the standards to be used in Senegal, implying no such standards exist.

note: Author's opinion that harmonised standards are lacking and an agency should mandate them; analysis, not a dated statement of absence or drafting.
